# Festivus

> Open source Physical AI platform by Haptic. A curated dataset of robots, policies, environments, datasets, and benchmarks plus the tooling to explore, contribute to, and deploy them.

Festivus is for engineers and researchers building agents that act in the physical world. It provides a typed, browseable corpus and a public HTTP API so AI agents and humans can discover compatible robots, policies, and datasets without re-scraping the web.

The platform is split across three runnable surfaces and a typed dataset: a Next.js web app for browsing and editing records, an Express API serving the dataset over HTTP, and JSON seed files under `data/` covering robots, policies, datasets, papers, benchmarks, environments, tasks, simulations, compatibility edges, and deploy notes.

## Docs

- [Architecture](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): system design, monorepo layout, and trade-offs (~2K tokens).
- [Public API](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/public-api.md): endpoint list, rate limits, auth, and curl examples (~2K tokens).
- [Agentic-first principle](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/agentic-first.md): the design principle behind the platform (~1K tokens).
- [Coding guide](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/coding-guide.md): code style and conventions for contributors (~3K tokens).
- [Prompting guide](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/prompting-guide.md): conventions for talking to the in-app agent (~1K tokens).
- [Testing](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/testing.md): test strategy (~1K tokens).
- [Observability](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/observability.md): metrics and traces we emit (~1K tokens).
- [Brand](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/brand.md): voice and visual identity (~1K tokens).

## API

- [API base](https://api.festivus.hapticlabs.ai): production data API. Read routes are public. `GET /v1/robots`, `/v1/policies`, `/v1/datasets`, `/v1/benchmarks`, `/v1/environments`, `/v1/tasks`, `/v1/papers`, `/v1/deploy-notes`, `/v1/stats`, `/health` (negligible — JSON responses, see docs).
- [Anonymous rate limit](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/docs/public-api.md#rate-limits): 50 req/s per IP, no key required.
- [Keyed rate limit](https://festivus.hapticlabs.ai/settings/api-keys): 500 req/s per key. Header: `X-API-Key: fek_<key>`.
- [Sitemap](https://festivus.hapticlabs.ai/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL (large; ~30K URLs).

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus): Apache 2.0, monorepo (Next.js + Express + Postgres).
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): code via PR with DCO sign-off; data via the in-app `/contribute` flow (~1K tokens).
- [Security](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private disclosure channel and SLA (under 1K tokens).

## Optional

- [API skill (api/skill.md)](https://github.com/Haptic-AI/open-festivus/blob/main/api/skill.md): what the data API can answer, framed for agents (~1K tokens).
